name: Project Context page: list the repo's docs, filter, read one, rescan
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the read-only Project Context page on the seeded demo repo acme/payments-api. Opens it from the sidebar; the six fixture docs (e2e/fixtures/payments-api-mirror, committed into a git mirror by scripts/e2e-fixture-mirror.sh) are listed with their type and '≈ N tokens'; a filter that matches nothing shows the empty-filter note and a narrowing filter keeps one doc; the selected doc 'specs/security-baseline.md' renders as Markdown next to 'Used by N agents'; Rescan refetches and the footer reads 'N files · ≈ T tokens total · scanned … ago'. That the page has no edit/new/upload/delete control is asserted by ContextView.test.tsx, not here: agent-browser has no 'is absent' wait. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB and the fixture mirror (hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml set DEVDIGEST_CLONE_DIR); reads only, so it can run in any order.
